checks.text: Typing `#FF5733` in the field labelled "Hex" updates the field labelled "R" to "255", the field labelled "G" to "87", and the field labelled "B" to "51".
With the current color set to `#FF5733`, the field labelled "Contrast on White" shows "3.02" and the field labelled "Contrast on Black" shows "10.45".
Typing `128` in the field labelled "R", `64` in the field labelled "G", and `32` in the field labelled "B" updates the field labelled "Hex" to `#804020`.
Clicking the button "Generate Palette" adds five new swatches to the palette grid, and the first swatch displays the hex value `#FF5733` when the current color is `#FF5733`.
Clicking the button "Copy Hex" with the current color `#FF5733` changes the button text to "Copied!" for 2 seconds, and the clipboard contains `#FF5733`.
Typing `50` in the field labelled "H" and `100` in the field labelled "S" with the current color `#FF5733` updates the field labelled "Hex" to `#FF0000`.
Clicking the button "Remove" on the second swatch in the palette grid removes that swatch, and the grid now shows one fewer swatch.

Typing `10` in the field labelled "L" of the OKLCH section updates the field labelled "Hex" to a darker variant of the current color, specifically `#0A0503` when starting from `#FF5733` with H=25 and C=0.15.
Reload keeps the current color: after setting the hex to `#123456` and reloading the page, the field labelled "Hex" still shows `#123456`.
